description: This file defines the EmployeeDao class, which provides data access methods for Employee entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functionality for retrieving, saving, deleting employees, and managing relationships such as supervisors and subordinates. The class interacts with the database via Doctrine query builders and handles search filtering, pagination, and related entity retrieval.

classes.name: EmployeeDao
classes.description: A data access class for Employee entities, providing methods to retrieve, create, update, delete, and perform complex queries related to Employee objects within the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Returns a list of Employee entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Retrieves an array of employee numbers filtered by provided search parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of employees matching search criteria.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an Employee entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches an Employee entity by its employee number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpNumbers
methods.description: Checks which employee numbers exist in the database from a list.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Recursively retrieves subordinate employee IDs under a given supervisor, optionally including the chain of subordinates.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns total number of employees, optionally excluding terminated employees.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinate Employee entities under a specific supervisor, with options to include terminated employees and subordinate chains.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Determines if a given employee number corresponds to a supervisor.

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Fetches the reporting method record between a subordinate and supervisor.

methods.name: getEmpNumberList
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers, optionally excluding terminated employees.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees from the database given their employee numbers.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Recursively retrieves supervisor employee IDs for a given subordinate, optionally including the chain.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Retrieves the work shift for an employee by employee number.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeeListForWorkShift
methods.description: Gets employees available for assignment to a work shift based on search filters.

methods.name: getEmailList
methods.description: Returns a list of all employee email addresses.

methods.name: isEmailAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an email address is available (not used by any employee).

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Verifies whether a given employee ID is unique within the system.
